record_body:
OVERVIEW
- Source: PLG intent signal routing (pilot cohort).
- Outcome: Marked FALSE POSITIVE after outreach triggered complaint. Added suppression tuning notes for signal router.

FIRMOGRAPHICS / CONTEXT
- Quartz Commerce (quartzcommerce.com)
- SMB ecomm platform team; appears to be vendor shopping / planning, not active build.
- No evidence of Redwood API usage: no API keys, no tokens, no spend, no repeated 429s.

WHAT TRIGGERED THE ROUTE (INTENT SIGNALS)
- Pricing page viewed (likely from corporate IP range).
- Security FAQ viewed (SOC2 / audit logs / retention pages).
- Dedicated docs viewed (capacity + SLOs section).
- Events occurred close together and originally scored as "high intent".

AE NOTES (Avery J.)
- 2025-05-12: sent standard Day 0 template (Dedicated intro + quick offer to sanity-check scale/security needs).
- 2025-05-13: reply from prospect: "Not evaluating vendors right now. Just collecting info for second half of the year planning. Please remove me / don’t reach out." (tone: annoyed, not hostile).
- Task closed and tagged: false_positive / intent_only.

SUPPORT / CUSTOMER COMPLAINT
- SUP-3392 opened: "Unwanted sales outreach triggered by signal".
- Response: apologized; clarified outreach came from product interest signals; confirmed we will suppress further contact.
- Set Do Not Contact at company level; ensured marketing suppression as well.

ROOT CAUSE / LEARNINGS
- Intent-only signals (docs/pricing/security) are too noisy without corroborating product usage.
- The three events were in a single research session (same day) and do not imply near-term buying.
- This is exactly the failure mode we’re trying to avoid in pilot: spam + false positives.

SUPPRESSION TUNING (ACTION ITEMS IMPLEMENTED)
- Gate #1: require baseline activity OR explicit inbound request.
  - If tokens_last_14d == 0 AND no "contact sales/demo" conversion, do NOT create AE tasks from intent-only signals.
- Gate #2: require intent to be sustained.
  - >=2 intent events across >=2 different days within 7d window (avoid single-session research).
- Gate #3: marketing vs sales coordination.
  - If nurture email sent within last 5d, suppress AE task unless there is a usage threshold (spend velocity / 429s / sustained tokens).
- Gate #4: strict DNC.
  - Honor DNC for 90d minimum; block all auto-task creation + timeline notes.

CURRENT STATUS
- Suppressed / no outreach.
- Keep on low-touch nurture only. Re-open only if we see real product usage (tokens/spend) or inbound conversion.

INTERNAL LINKS / REFERENCES
- Slack: false positive discussion (pilot tuning): sources/slack/sales/1746468910-false-positive-example-quartz-commerce.json
- Support: SUP-3392
- Playbook + cadence templates referenced for what we used / what we changed.
